Description: A modified version of the Shadow Clone Technique that allows the user to create a clone but constructed from solid lightning. Lightning Clones have no measurable weight and explode if exposed to a body of water. Creatures who have chakra sight can tell the clone is made of lightning and can distinguish the clone from the original.
When this jutsu is cast, by spending 16 chakra, you summon one Clone. You can spend 8 additional chakra to summon 1 additional Clone. You can spend 8 additional chakra in this way to summon additional Clones up to 3 times per casting.

Rank: D-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: 25 Foot Cone Duration: Instant
Components: HS, CM Cost: 5 Chakra Keywords: Ninjutsu, Lightning Release Description: A wave of electrical force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 25-foot cone originating from you must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save a creature takes 4d4 Lightning damage are pushed back 10 feet and Shocked. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.
Overcharge. A creature who fails their saving throw has their initiative score reduced by 2, falling in the initiative order accordingly as a result. A creature can only have their initiative changed twice as a result of this effect.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and increase the damage by 2d4 and knock back distance 5ft.
